Every word here is quotable back to one Wikidata item carrying one ISO 3166-1 code, so somebody who doubts an entry can go and look rather than take it on trust. A list edited for taste, however sensible each edit, stops being checkable the moment the first edit is made, and then the only argument for it is that somebody typed it carefully.";
